create_rotation_config: create a BaseRotationConfig dataclass with an algorithm name for a new rotation transform
register_rotation_algorithm: register a new BaseRotation subclass using the register decorator with an algorithm name
apply_rotation_to_model: apply a registered rotation algorithm to a PyTorch model using from_config and apply_to_model
check_quantization_scheme: check if a quantization scheme like MXFP8 supports rotation transforms using check_supported_schemes
instantiate_rotation_from_config: instantiate the correct BaseRotation subclass from a config using the from_config factory method
